115: 	action = function(self, t)
116: 		local weapon = self:hasWeaponType("steamsaw")

118: 		local tg = {type="hit", range=self:getTalentRange(t)}
119: 		local x, y, target = self:getTarget(tg)
120: 		if not x or not y or not target then return nil end
121: 		if core.fov.distance(self.x, self.y, x, y) > 1 then return nil end

129: 
130: 			-- Go through all spell effects
131: 			for eff_id, p in pairs(target.tmp) do
132: 				local e = target.tempeffect_def[eff_id]

134: 					effs[#effs+1] = {"effect", eff_id}

136: 			end
137: 
138: 			-- Go through all sustained spells

140: 			for tid, act in pairs(target.sustain_talents) do

142: 					local talent = target:getTalentFromId(tid)
143: 					if not talent.is_mind then
144: 						sustains[#sustains+1] = {"talent", tid}
145: 					end
146: 				end
147: 			end
148: 
149: 			for i = 1, t.getRemoveCount(self, t) do
150: 				if #effs == 0 then break end
151: 				local eff = rng.tableRemove(effs)
152: 
153: 				if eff[1] == "effect" then
154: 					target:dispel(eff[2], self)
155: 				end
156: 			end
157: 			if self:getTalentLevel(t) >= 3 then
158: 				for i = 1, t.getRemoveCount(self, t) do
159: 					local sustain = rng.table(sustains)
160: 					if sustain then
161: 						target:dispel(sustain[2], self)
162: 					end
163: 				end
164: 			end
165: 		end
166: 
167: 		return true
168: 	end,
